messages:
sara: Starting micro-canary now — rolling v3.2.1 to 10% traffic in eu-west1. Change window ok until 15:30 UTC. release-notes: https://go/release/3.2.1 :rocket:

deploybot: [automated] initiating staged rollout: canary=10% -> model-service:v3.2.1. PID=deploy-1729000000. ETA warmup 2m.

mike: ack. watching latency + error rates. can someone pin the old config as fallback?

anya: pinned v3.2.0 as fallback on routing policy `fallback: v3.2.0` — command: `redwoodctl rollout pin model-service --version v3.2.0`

ryan: seeing a tiny tail in p99 for text-generation (eu-west1) after 1m, +20ms vs baseline. p50 stable. :eyes:

lisa: also noticing ~0.4% increase in inference timeouts in the same slice (10-12s requests). small but trending.

mike: can we hold at 10% until we confirm? Recommend HOLD.

anya: holding traffic now — `redwoodctl rollout hold deploy-1729000000` — deploybot should confirm.

deploybot: [automated] rollout status: canary=10% (HELD) — reason: manual hold by anya. PID=deploy-1729000000.

ryan: running quick diff on kernel selection and kv-cache hit rates, pushing logs: `logs.redwood/model-service/v3.2.1/1729000000`

lisa: from quick look KV hit rate down 3% for long prompts, maybe cache warming mismatch with new attention kernel. recommending a 5% rollback sample to isolate.

mike: agree. let's roll back 5% to v3.2.0 (keep 5% on v3.2.1 for signal). Anyone object?

sara: fine by me. do it and capture sample IDs. include trace ids in the postmortem if it grows.

anya: executing partial rollback: `redwoodctl rollout adjust --pid deploy-1729000000 --set 5%:v3.2.1,95%:v3.2.0` — ETA 30s

deploybot: [automated] adjusted staged rollout: 5%->v3.2.1,95%->v3.2.0. Status=IN_PROGRESS. Capturing traces under `trace/1729000000/` :white_check_mark:

ryan: good. I'll watch p99 and timeouts for the 5% bucket and report back in 5m.

lisa: adding note to release thread: observed kv-cache hit drop — candidate cause: kernel switch change. tagging infra and ml-opt.

mike: thumbs if we keep hold until next steps confirmed. :thumbsup:

sara: :thumbsup: holding overall rollout. scheduling a follow-up at 15:10 UTC to decide resume vs rollback fully.

deploybot: [automated] thread updated: rollout paused by sara. Audit log: https://go/audit/deploy-1729000000

(END)
